notes.notes:
-Now you can hold down the middle mouse button to rotate the camera, and double-clicking the middle button will reset the camera.
-Added Credits list in the options menu.
-Slightly reduced the enemy rank in the late game.
-Each turret of the KV-6 now individually targets enemies.
-Slightly increased the speed of the KV-6.
-Completed the translation work for all languages in the early access version.

-Increased the overall rank for selectable ally, turrets, and items in the store.
-Fixed a bug that caused a shortage of high-rank enemies in the late game.
-Fixed a bug that caused the spawned allies from Maria's skill to be fixed.
-Fixed a bug where vehicle turrets and wheels were not reset when exit "Try the vehicle".

Modifications to Yulia's "Panzer Ace!" strategy effect:
2. Whenever you choose a AP turret, Muzzle Velocity +3% -> Critical +5%
5. Whenever you choose a Yulia's skill, Critical +10% -> Reload speed +10%
9. Whenever you choose a APCR turret, Probability of shell go through target after penetration +3% -> +10%

-Fixed the bug where enemies on the Forest map were blocked by trees.
-Fixed the bug where vehicles couldn't be flipped over.
-Fixed the bug where boss battle music would occasionally disappear.
-Attempted to fix the feature where enemies would stack on top of each other.

-New vehicle: Deacon, a 6-Pdr tank destroyer that roams the deserts of North Africa!
-New strategy of Yulia: Panzer Ace! This is a strategy center around AP shells.
-Added Steam cloud save functionality, allowing save synchronization across multiple devices!

-New vehicle: Churchill Mk VIII! A heavy tank that can firing 95mm HEAT shells!
-Fixed the issue with ally units stacking together.
-Increased randomness when rerolling missions.
-AI tanks will now flip themselves back.
-Increased the damage of the Tiger's HEAT from 2 to 3.

-New vehicle: Type 91 Armored Car!
-This week's new vehicles: Deacon, Churchill Mk VIII!
-Added the music for when you are far away from KV-6!
-Weakened the stats of Pz.III Z and White Tiger, as they are now early and mid-game bosses.
-Continued to reduce the number of regular enemies in boss battles.
-Turret mounted MGs now rotate with the mouse.
-Optimized forest map by reducing the amount of vegetation.
-Adjusted tank spawn positions to avoid stacking.
-When players respawn, nearby enemies will be moved away.

Balance adjustments:
-Significantly increased armor's bonus against collision damage.
-Reduced reload time of Churchill AVRE from 15 to 10.
-Reduced reload time of KV-2 from 15 to 12.
-Reduced reload time of Sturmtiger from 25 to 20 and damage from 45 to 36.

-New boss: KV-6! Behold, the queen of Multi-turret!
-Stretched the levels to 9 battles, including three boss battles.
-Turret mounted machine guns no longer automatically attack enemies.
-IS-3's penetration/damage values: 23/8 -> 20/10.
-Reduced enemy spawn rate by 50% in boss battles.
-Fixed a bug where engine power was not correctly upgraded during vehicle upgrades. Apologies for the inconvenience!

-New vehicle: T29! A heavy tank equipped with a 105mm cannon!
-Added machine guns to T29, T30, T34, and IS-3!
-Attempted to optimize AI pathfinding.
-Fixed a bug where the muzzle ray was longer than the actual range.
-Fixed a bug where the muzzle ray would not display when the enemy was too close.
-Fixed the incorrect duration of the gun reloading animation.

-Add TOG1! A land cruiser that is 10 meters long and weighs 80 tons! You can even add an additional turret to it's back!
-Viewing one event in the roadmap will not disable another now.
-Maus's  penetration and damage changed from 30/8 to 25/14.
-Super Pershing's armor changed from 25/8/6 to 21/8/6.
-Tiger II's armor changed from 30/9/9 to 25/9/9.
-Fixed the enemy spawn position errors and stacking bugs.

Early wishes! Happy new year!
-New vehicle: IS-3 heavy tank! With such a stunning appearance, the reload speed no longer matters!
-Added new character illustration for Maria! The new illustration is now the default display.
-Reduced the number of enemies in the survive mission of Forest.
-Optimized the environment of Nameless Forest. If you experience any frame drops, you can try lowering the graphics quality in the options menu.

-New map: Nameless Forest! It's still in the initial version, so please give me your feedback!
-New vehicle: Archer! The Valentine tank chassis equipped with a 17-pound gun, but is it really worth it?
-Armor of KV-1 (Zis-5) changed from 11/10/8 to 10/8/8.
-Armor of KV-1S changed from 10/8/8 to 9/7/7, and its level changed from 5 to 4.

-New vehicle: M3 "Grant" medium tank, equipped with a 75mm hull gun and a 37mm turret!
-Added animation to the mission objectives on the map.

-New vehicle: T-35 M1939! And it's sub weapon "Breakthrough Command": The reload speed of nearby ally +30% for 5 seconds and command them to attack target direction.
-Buffed the Assault Command: increased mobility effect from 30% to 50% and reduced cooldown time from 20 seconds to 15 seconds.
-Modified the initial vehicle list that doesn't require unlocking: T-28, T-35, NBFZ, Cruiser Mk I. Other vehicles will now require unlocking in order to guide newcomers to start with relatively simpler vehicles.
-Added special effects to commands and healing.
-Fixed a bug where ally units would sometimes be too lazy to move.

-New vehicle: Pz.Bef.Wg.IV J! A special command version of panzer IV that can command your teammates!
-Next week's new vehicles: Archer, M3 Grant!
-Fixed the bug that prevented the BM-8-24 from firing after increasing its magazine size.
-Reduced the firing spread of the BM-8-24 by 25%.

-New vehicle: BM-8-24, a light rocket launcher mounted on the T-60 tank chassis. 
-Winter event has started! The students have decorated the vehicles, hoping you will like it!
-Yulia has added you as a friend!
-Started collecting gameplay data for balance adjustments using Unity's built-in services. It will only be enabled with your consent and can be turn off anytime in the options menu.
-Camera shake effects now weaken based on the weight of the player vehicle.
-You have taught the crew members to distinguish friend from foe based on engine sounds. Now, the markers for friendly units in the fog of war are different from enemies!
-Updated my sponsorship page (www.patreon.com/ScarletAcademy). From now on, I will post development logs  (and cat pictures) about this game's progress from inception to completion every weekend. Make sure to check it out if you're interested!

-New vehicle: Jagdtiger! The most feared tank destroyer of World War II!
-Fixed various bugs discovered in the previous version.

-Sophia's new skill "Care": Every 7 seconds during battle, Heal 2 crew member
-Sophia's new skill "Fortitude": Whenever a crew member is lost, Combat Effectiveness +5%
-New stat "Resistance": Reducing the damage taken by the crew, with a maximum reduction of 90%.
-New hull upgrades "Spall shield": Resistance +10%，Mobility -5%
-New hull upgrades "Ventilation": Resistance -5%, Reload Speed +10%

-Recently added pre-war vehicles were significantly weaker than the average level, so their weights have been adjusted! Most existing vehicles have been upgraded in ranks, while the weaker vehicles remain unchanged. The maximum vehicle rank is now 9!
-Friendly markers have been added to allies, so please stop shooting them.
-Lowered the minimum graphics settings to accommodate lower-end configurations. If you're still experiencing lag, give it a try.
-The player vehicle crew UI now displays the crew members' health.

-New vehicle: Morris LRC! Equipped with a 14mm anti-tank rifle and a machine gun turret.
-New rocket turrets: 15 cm Nebelwerfer 41 (Rank 4) and 21 cm Nebelwerfer 42 (Rank 6)!
-Next week's new vehicles: Jagdtiger and BM-8-24!
-New vehicle type: Armored Cars! These are the small vehicles that struggle for survival in this tank-centric game.

-The garage vehicle tab now displays the number of purchased vehicles.
-The damage and magazine size boosted by strategies are now displayed on the turret cards.
-M16 penetration increased from 2 to 3, turret rank increased from 2 to 3.
-Fixed the track animation for the Renault FT and slightly adjusted its maneuverability.
-Manually adjusted the scaling sizes for each turret.
-B1bis secondary gun now fires after pressing the spacebar.
-Fixed a bug with the Sd.Kfz.2 where it would randomly drop mines after using the "Let me play!" skill.
-Fixed an issue with the incorrect display of initial magazine count after increasing magazine size through strategies.

-New vehicle: Renault FT-17, the world's earliest tank with a turret!
-Sunday's new strategy: Determination! This is a series of enhancements for magazine weapons!
-New keyword Super-light: Engine boost refill speed +100%
-T-38 also received the Super-light keyword.
-The vehicle flip function now brings you back to the surface if you fall underground.
-Fixed a bug where the combination of "Assistant" and "Stop Thinking" would result in fewer than 2 options.

And if you enjoy this game, a small donation can help me in creating better content!
A big thank you to all of my sponsors!
https://patreon.com/ScarletAcademy

-Added new illustration for Sophia!
-Fixed a bug where Sunday's "Stop Thinking" skill did not provide a free reroll when selecting a mission.
-Exiting the reward selection from the roadmap no longer counts as a selection, but it disables another choice on a different path.
-Adjusted the turret's range when controlled by AI to match the range when controlled by the player.
-Adjusted the map boundaries, and now enemies outside the boundaries are visible.
-Further adjustments to various maps for environmental enhancements.
-Modified the display style of buffs.

Adjusted skill effects:
-Yulia's "Adrenaline Rush": When you destroy an enemy, Reload Speed +30% for 3 seconds, up to 3 times.
-Sophia's "Calm": After being attacked, Reload Speed +30% for 3 seconds, up to 3 times.
-Sunday's "Victory Rush": When you destroy an enemy, Mobility +30% for 3 seconds, up to 3 times.

-Currently working on a new map, so updates may not be as frequent. Stay tuned!
-Sunday's new skill "Stop thinking": When facing a choice, remove 2 options, and gain 5 free reroll.
-Yulia's new skill "Let me play!": Main weapon will now automatically target and fire, and greatly increased your targeting speed.
-Sophia's reload speed upon being hit and Yulia's reload speed upon kill no longer stack, but instead refresh their durations.
-Added graphics quality settings in the options menu. If adjusting the setting improves your framerate, please let me know!
-Made some adjustments to the old maps.
-Exiting the reward selection directly from the roadmap now counts as making a choice.
-The remaining free reroll is now indicated.

-Next week's new vehicle: Morris LRC and Renault FT-17!
-Added some dialogue boxes that you will see in the game.
-Added facial expressions to dialogues for many characters.
-Now you can view upgrades you have in the bottom right corner when selecting rewards.
-Increased the number of pineapples obtained from killing bosses.
-Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when dying in the tutorial.
-I upgraded Unity to the latest version in hopes of resolving some people's crashing issues. But one thing for sure is that it has brought some new issues now.
-Updated the translations for Japanese and Traditional Chinese. Thanks to 白雪, 马车, and KAREYA for their contributions!
Some new character illustrations have been added, you can enable them in the Options panel!

-New vehicle: T34! A heavy tank equipped with a 120mm gun!
-Compressed tank icons, reducing memory usage by approximately 10%.
-Modified tank categorization in the garage, now organized by tank type!
-After weapon upgrades are completed, will no longer close the panel directly.
-Fixed a bug where mines could block shells.

-Sunny has added you as a friend!
-Tried to optimize memory usage.
-Now the save files for the demo version and the playtest version are separate to avoid any errors or conflicts (heard that a poor guy lost his save file because of this yesterday). The playtest version will automatically inherit the save file from the demo, and in the future, the full version will inherit the save file from the playtest.
-Fixed a bug where re-entering the game would cause previously obtained buffs to disappear.
-Fixed a bug where the cursor would shake after the player was hit.
-Increased the Damage of M41M from 7 to 9.

-New vehicle added: T30! A heavy tank equipped with a 155mm cannon! 
It's been a while since we had a normal tank like this. 
By the way, HE shells can also critical hit target, dealing double damage, which is known as the overpressure mechanic.
-Reduced the aggression of bosses, but increased their damage and resistance. The goal is to lower the difficulty when first encountering bosses, increase the duration of battles.
-Chat backgrounds in the Contacts now display character illustrations to avoid confusion.
-"Damage" and "Reload time" multipliers are now displayed in the pause menu during battles.
-Updated several English and Russian texts. Thanks to friends Considerer and Tippy for their contributions!

Balance adjustments:
-M41M: Damage reduced from 9 to 7
-Churchill Mk. IV: Damage increased from 1 to 2
-Tiger II: Damage increased from 3 to 4

-Sophia's new strategy "Bigger is Better" has been added, which focuses on building around HE shells.
-Next week, two new vehicles, T30 and T34, will be added!

So, the core functionalities of the "Contacts" and "Strategy Selection" systems are considered complete. Next, I will work on an advanced difficulty system, and then new maps and bosses

-New system, Contacts: You can use this chat software to communicate with members of the tank club. You can access the Contacts from the top left corner of the main menu. More text with other characters will be added soon.
-New system, Strategy Selection: Members of the tank club will propose their strategy ideas in the Contacts. You can spend "Day Off" to discuss with them and turn the strategies into reality. This will provide benefits in future battles. More strategies from various characters will be added soon.
-The Damage of the Tortoise has been increased from 3 to 4, and the MG magazine capacity has been corrected to 450.

-New vehicle added: A39 Tortoise! A 94mm 32-pounder gun carrier with faster reload speed and movement speed compared to the T95
-A very important new system will be added tomorrow!
-Added new global resource, Day off: The days when you don't have to work. You can still choose to spend time with the students and teach them something new. 
Day off can be obtained after completing a BOSS level and will be useful in the new system.

-New vehicle added: T95! A tank destroyer equipped with a 105mm cannon, and it has an additional empty turret slot on its back!
-A very important new system will be added in a few days. Stay tuned!
-Character illustrations are being remade. Stay tuned!
-Reduced recoil for machine guns and autocannons, making Sd.Kfz.2 more enjoyable to play with.
-Sd.Kfz.2 will no longer encounter pivot-turning options during hull upgrades.

-New vehicle: Sd.Kfz.2! A half-track vehicle capable of deploying anti-tank mines! It also has an empty turret slot on its back!
-New vehicle joining next week: T95, Tortoise!
-I will be away for the weekend, will continue to update next Tuesday.

-Added stabilizers to the T-28, Cruiser Mk I, Pz.II F, and Ka-Mi.
-Now all vehicles have stabilizer effects when their speed is below 10 km/h.
-Made the reticle more visible.
-Fixed the issue where the projectiles of the Sturmtiger would bounce.
-Keybinding instructions are now displayed in the pause menu.
-Fixed the issue where roadmap lines would disappear when returning from a battle.

Balance adjustments:
-Increased the reload time of the Sturmtiger: 20 -> 30.
-Decreased the reload time of the KV-2: 35 -> 20.
-Decreased the reload time of the Churchill AVRE: 35 -> 20.

-New vehicle: Sturmtiger! The flat top comes with an empty turret slot that can be customized.
-Added a new turret keyword "Stabilizer": Gradually increase Critical even during movement.
-Added stabilizers to the turrets of A1E1, 38t, Calliope, M4A2, and M4A3E2.
-Increased the rate at which critical increases during aiming.
-Added a dot in the reticle to indicate whether penetration is possible.
-Adjusted the ranges of various weapons. The ranges now range from highest to lowest as follows:
[list]
[*] Long-range: Rockets, HEAT.
[*] Mid-range: AP, APCR, HVAP.
[*] Short-range: HE, Bullet.
[/list]

-Added reticle that displays critical hit rate.
-Critical increases continuously when the player locks onto a target, with a faster increase when closer and a decrease when moving.
-The center of the field of view now moves with the player's aiming direction, with the distance depending on the weapon's range.
-Penetration no longer decreases with distance.
-Removed critical attribute from turret cards.
-Reduced mobility and rotation speed of bosses.

-New vehicle: Mobelwagen!
-Increased AI intelligence, significantly improving allys' combat effectiveness.
-Added a few dialogues to the weapon upgrade panel.
-Fixed the bug where character dialogue sound effects and text did not match.
-Now you can easily push allys.
-Reduced armor values of all bosses by 20%.

-New multi-turreted tank: Type 95 Heavy!
-Increase AI intelligence, optimize situations where bosses get stuck.
-Fix bug where enemies can be killed twice.
-Fix bug where Yulia's range boost effect disappears after player death.

-Add HEAT shells: Explodes upon colliding with any object, causing area damage equal to (200% Damage - Armor). Penetration does not decrease with distance.
-New mechanics: Penetration gradually decrease 50% as projectile travels.
-New affix Fin stabilised: Spread -30%, Critical damage +30%
-The ammunition of the Pz. IV F1 has been changed to HEAT rounds, with a penetration and damage of 8/1.
-Add a Tiger E turret with HEAT rounds to the turret pool, with a penetration and damage of 11/2.

-New vehicle: BA-10 armored car!
-Added the ability to view all upgrades in the roadmap UI.
-Added the ability to change turrets in the roadmap UI.
-Added some character dialogues.
-Reduced the size of the sub turret of TOG2
-Fixed a bug that allowed the main turret of the TOG2 to be placed on the sub turret slot directly.

-The vehicles to be added next week: Möbelwagen, BA-10!
-Increased the secondary turret's target acquisition speed.
-Fixed bugs related to changing the secondary turret.
-Fixed a bug where selling turrets would result in unexpected behavior.
-Attempted to fix a bug with reloading speed animation errors.
-Fixed a bug where AI tanks would not attack when obstructed by other tanks.
-Attempted to fix a bug where the order of turret in storage menu was not consistent with the order of turret changes.
-Fixed a bug where sometimes dropped turrets would not be picked up at the end of a battle.

-The last cruiser tank Comet, compared to the Challenger, is equipped with a simplified version of the 17-pounder gun for better protection.
-Due to some strange new rules of Steam, please manually join the beta branch for latest updates!(Right click Playtest game-Properties-Betas-Beta Participation)
-An empty turret slot has been added to the TOG2, so you can add turret yourself!
-The TOG2 (28-pounder gun) has increased Damage to 3, with critical hit rate reduced back to 10%.
-Attempts have been made to reduce lag through a preloading interface.
-Fixed a bug where affixes could stack abnormally. I will add affix enhancement functionality in the future!

-New vehicle: Cruiser Mk.VIII, Challenger, is equipped with a 17-pounder gun on the Cromwell hull. It has excellent mobility and can penetrate any visible object.
-Now, dismantling a turret with affixes allows you to transfer its affixes to other turrets!
-Added Maria's combat dialogue.
-Increased the randomness of mission rewards.
-The frame rate limit has been removed
-Reduced the penetration and armor buffs against enemies when using advanced vehicles, and instead increased the enemy's reaction speed, reloading speed, and mobility.
-Fixed a bug where Yulia's "Warm-up" skill wouldn't stack at the start of each battle.
-Fixed the issue where enemies would survive from lethal explosive.
-Fixed the issue where firing the sub turret in bushes wouldn't remove the stealth mode.
-Fixed UI display issues with the sub weapon reloading.
-Fixed the problem where bosses would lock onto players through walls.
-The aiming line will no longer be displayed for enemies outside the field of view.

-Added a 28-pounder version of the TOG2 turret to the turret pool.
-Added Pivot-turning to the A1E1, improved the pivot-turning speed of the Type 5 Chi-Ri.
-Ready racks replenishment will no longer be reset by firing.
-The replenishment speed of Ready racks is now affected by the reloading speed.
-Ready racks will now be replenished in the background.
-The replenishment time of Ready racks has been extended to 150% of the reloading time.
-Fixed the issue of incomplete Ready racks at the start of battles.
-Exiting the test drive in the garage will now reset the reloading

-New vehicle: Type 5 Chi-Ri medium tank!
-Ready racks: When having ready racks, reloading will be significantly faster. The ready racks will start replenishing after reloading is completed.

-Finally optimized the aiming logic for turrets with limited firing arcs.
-Now the acceleration and max speed of vehicles will be closer to their paper values.
-The first reward event is now fixed to be Turret.
-Fixed the pause menu's power-to-weight ratio display.
-Fixed the bug where collision damage was not triggering.

-New vehicle: A1E1 Independent, a multi-turret tank from the United Kingdom. The main turret features a high rate of fire three-pounder gun, along with four machine gun turrets.
-New attribute, Resistance: Reduces the damage received by crew members.
-Decreased the enemy initial rank when using advanced vehicles and instead increased enemy resistance.
-Pz.III Z now has a 50% resistance, the White Tiger now has a 75% resistance.
-More changes related to crew members will be added tomorrow.

-New Vehicle: Churchill AVRE! The Churchill "Armoured Vehicle Royal Engineers" is equipped with a 230mm mortar, capable of devastating enemy forces in a wide area.
-Added to the turret pool: IS-2 (HE), with a Damage of 14.
-Splash damage of HE shells now decays with distance and can be blocked by buildings.

Balance adjustments:
-Increased the reaction speed of ally and enemy units, enhancing the scouting range of ally.
-Increased initial backup crew count to 21.
-Adjusted Damage of BT-42 to 10 (previously 8).
-Adjusted Damage of Chi-Ha short gun to 12 (previously 9), and upgraded its rank from 1 to 2.
-Adjusted Damage of KV-2 to 18 (previously 12), and upgraded its rank from 3 to 4.
-Adjusted Damage of M12 to 20 (previously 14), and upgraded its rank from 4 to 5.

-New vehicle: TOG2! This is a vehicle donated by Chinese tank commanders!
-Tried adding AP and HE versions of the M26 turret to the turret pool. More will be added in the future!
-Your tank is possessed by a witch! (Decoration system experiment!)

-New vehicle: M26!
-Decrease armor values of M4A3E2 from 18/11/10 to 18/8/6.
-Improve maneuverability of M8 Greyhound.
-Increase turret selling price.
-Highlight changed attributes with a special color when upgrading weapons.
-Fix a bug that displays incorrect penetration values when upgrading weapons.
-Fix a bug where some vehicles using AP shells have the vfx and sound of HE shells.
-Remake the preview image of M41M.
-Fix a bug where M12 turret appears too early in the game.

-New vehicle: M4A3E2!
-Weapon upgrades are now a permanent event in roadmap!
-Due to the trick of witches, all projectiles have transformed into pumpkins!
-Reduced traction for some wheeled vehicles to decreased the chance of rolling over.

Balance adjustments:
-Modified the effect of the "Capped" affix: Penetration +2.
-Modified the effect of the "Ballistic Capped" prefix: Penetration +20%.
-Modified the effect of the "Rocket-Propelled" prefix: Muzzle velocity +30%.
-Increased the Damage of Panther G to 3 and the critical to 30%.

New Event: Weapon Upgrade! You can dismantle one turret to strengthen another based on its ammunition type, allowing even low-level turrets to be useful until the end! 
Here are the corresponding turret ammunition affix upgrades:
-Bullet - Tracer: Critical +30%
-HVAP - Ballistic Capped: Muzzle velocity +30%
-AP - Capped: Penetration +30%
-APCR - Discarding Sabot: Penetration +50%, Damage -50%
-HE - High-capacity: Damage +30%
-Rocket - Rocket-propelled: Range +50%

-New vehicle: Italian M41M! The first tank destroyer added to the game!
-A very important new system will be added tomorrow! (This is not a drill this time!)
-All machine gun sub turrets have been removed from the turret pool.

-Added Japanese localization! Thanks to the contribution made by a player!
-Yulia's new skill, Memorize weakness: When you attack an enemy from the front, Critical +30%.
-Maria's new skill, Flanking: When you attack an enemy from behind, Critical +50%
-Pz.III Z has received an upgrade! Changed to a dual-barrel 50mm gun!
-Improved maneuverability of M2A2.
-Significantly increased firing range of B1Bis's hull-mounted gun.
-A very important new system will be introduced tomorrow!

- Added the 7th multi-turret tank: M2A2! 
- Made some minor memory optimizations and loading improvements to reduce lag. If you encounter any abnormal situations as a result, please let me know!
- Added descriptions for a batch of low-rank vehicles.

-New vehicle: Sherman Firefly!
-The critical attribute, which was added several versions ago, is now displayed on the turret card. It represents the probability of your shells hitting the weak spots inside enemy vehicles, causing an additional 100% damage.
-The default critical hit rate is 10%, HE shells have 0%, and the British uncapped AP shells have 30%.
-Fixed a bug where sometimes the shots wouldn't fire, which was actually due to the setting that prevented shooting if the mouse was on the UI.
-Continued to reduce the number of maus in high difficulty levels.

-I manually adjusted the mobility of each vehicle.  Let me know if there are still any issues with vehicles.
-Limited the probability of high rank enemies appearing in high difficulty levels to prevent overwhelming maus.
-Slightly increased the range of the SMK's main gun.

-The sixth multi-turreted tank: SMK! It has a 76mm main gun and a 45mm secondary gun, and it's free because it's a multi-turreted tank!
-Increased the intelligence of the bosses, but you'll have to experience it for yourself :)
-Adjusted vehicle handling, attempting to reduce the turning radius. Let me know if there are any issues.
-Reduced the delay for activating the vehicle flipping function after a player overturns, and the vehicle will retain its front-facing direction when flipped back.
-Adjusted the recoil and impact force of each gun.
-Changed the Chi-Ha Short Gun to a naval camouflage.
-Fixed the bug where the M12's barrel would explode.

-New Vehicle: Chi-Ha Short Gun, a Japanese 120mm self-propelled gun!
-Confirmed 3 new vehicles to be added this week: M41M, Firefly, Type 5 Medium Tank.
-Optimized the Mobility of the Maus and added pivot-turning.
-Fixed a bug where AI wouldn't attack after getting too close.

Balance adjustments:
-Player vehicle rank's impact on enemy strength is halved.
-Using vehicles higher than Rank1 will increase the initial mission difficulty (up to level 4). This will affect the rank of enemies, allies, and turrets in missions.

-First Rank 8 Vehicle: Maus!
-It took me a long time to figure out how to make it move :) 
-Player vehicles will also take armor damage now! The newbie protection is over, folks!
-Fixed the bug where APCR rounds would trigger multiple times on the same target.

-Added new vehicle BT-42, thanks to a player for creating its model.
-Changed ammunition for Flakpanzer 38 back to HVAP, with  Penetration/Damage of 3/1.
-Increasing HVAP armor damage by approximately 50%.
-Increased Damage of T-34-85 from 4 to 5.
-Fixed a bug where penetration and armor bonus on the side only applied to one side :(
-Fixed a bug where the rocket penetration of Pz.III Z was too high.

-Added PivotTurning to the B1Bis and swapped the main and sub weapons.
-Increased the Damage of the Calliope Rockets from 6 to 8 and added spread to all rocket projectiles.
-Increase the armor damage of small-caliber HE shells and decreased the armor damage of large-caliber HE shells.
-Reduced the rank of the Ostwind from 3 to 2.
-Optimized the sub turret's targeting range, which is now increased by approximately 20%.
-Added Traditional Chinese localization.

-New vehicle: Char B1bis, with a hull-mounted 76mm gun and fully traversable sub turret.
-Corrected and improved the firing arc of the sub turret for the Cruiser Tank MK1.
-Increased the Damage to 6 for the T-35, Pz.IV D, F1, and Pz.III N.
-Increased player's sub turret aiming speed by 25%.
-Fixed a bug where low-level turrets would appear in the shop.
-Continued to optimize the AI.

-Modify the enemy, turret, and ally extraction mechanism to gradually increase the probability of high rank vehicles appearing as the difficulty increases, rather than extracting within a fixed rank range.
-Fix the bug where the reroll result is similar to the previous one, yeah, this is a bug.
-Based on player feedback, we have redesigned a more realistic mantlet model for the KV-1.
-Further improve the AI pathfinding system.

-Sunday's new skill, Victory Rush: When you destroy an enemy, increase the Mobility by 30% for 3 seconds.
-Maria's new skill, One Last Kiss: The Penetration and Damage of the last 1 round(s) in your magazine are increased by 100%
-Fixed the issue with corrupted save files, automatically creating a new save file and providing compensation when this occurs.
-Fixed a bug where using new vehicles in older versions of the game would cause issues.
-Changed the main ammunition type of the White Tiger to HE rounds, with improved visual effects.
-The weight of the White Tiger has been increased to 120 tons, and Pz.III Z  to 60 tons.
-Fixed a bug with automatic reward selection.
-Attempted to fix the bug causing freezing during boss battles.
-Optimized AI pathfinding slightly.

-New vehicles added: Ostwind and Type 94 AA! 
-Added vehicle difficulty stat in the garage! 
-Changed the camo pattern of the Type 2 Ka-Mi, adjusted the tracks, suspension, and turret size.

-Added Type 2 Ka-Mi and Type 2 Ka-Mi(Pontoons)
-Adjusted the mobility of AS42

-Extended one-third of the total campaign length, added two new battles and more rewards.
-Strengthened the White Tiger, even made the model cooler.

notes.title: Update Preview for the Second Stage~~
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Zyf. ːsteamhappyː
The goals of the previous stage have been successfully achieved~~ 
It has been ten days since the release of the demo, and there has been a constant stream of people coming forward with suggestions, bug reports, and requests. 
I hope I haven't missed any of them. These have been extremely helpful to me, and I welcome more feedback in the future!

Now let me give you a report on what has been accomplished during this period:
[olist]
[*] The main forces of the Bug Legion have been eliminated.
[*] New vehicles have been added: Cruiser Mk I, Churchill, Hellcat, and Tiger II.
[*] The functionality to sell and sort turrets has been added.
[*] A settings interface has been added.
[*] Slightly improved gameplay experience.
[/olist]
The above is just the first step of a long journey. I know that the current version is far from qualifying as a DEMO version. However, I already know what I should do next:
[h2]1. Advanced Difficulty[/h2] I have noticed that some players have already started engaging in challenges and speedruns. It's apparently that current difficulty is not enough to satisfy our skilled tank commanders. More difficulties will be arranged soon!
[h2]2. Upgrades Outside of Battles[/h2] The system to train squad leaders will be introduced soon! You will be able to train a student from multiple directions to become a squad leader, and she will change the entire combat style afterwards.
[h2]3. Content Expansion[/h2] I will be adding at least three new vehicles every week, not to mention new skills, hull upgrades, and events. As for new maps and objectives, I will see what I can do.

Thank you, my friends! 😆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089194/3edb59bed3acfe9a5204bc4561192d728b7fe50e.png[/img]

-Three new vehicles confirmed for this week's update: T34 Calliope, Tiger II H, M12.
-Added a hidden mechanic - Critical Hit: Players have a very low chance to deal extra damage.
-Fixed a bug where completing a mission after the player's death would get stuck.
-Additionally, if the player completes a mission before the screen goes black after death, no backup crew 
 will be consumed!
-Optimized the armor display in the pause menu.
-Fixed tank display order issue in the garage.
-Now, pivot turning only takes effect when the vehicle is nearly stationary.
-Polished English text.

Adding new vehicles: Churchill Mk IV and M18 Hellcat!

-Fixing the bug with the oversized turret of the Cruiser Mk I. 
-Limiting the maximum number of enemies that can be spawned in Survival and Defense modes to 30. 
-Slightly reducing the difficulty of Survival mode.

Introducing the brand new multi-turreted tank - Cruiser Mk I. It features a 2-pounder gun with good penetration but lacks effectiveness in post-penetration effects. This tank has an astonishing loading speed and two 7.7mm machine gun turrets.
By the way, all multi-turreted tanks in this game are free and do not require unlocking. Enjoy playing!

-Adjusted the bonus and negative effects of concrete armor, as it was too powerful.
-Fixed some erroneous English texts.
-Resolved the issue of incorrect display of ammo count for the autocannon after player respawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089194/4db658802e9cc4007de5919a01c96d9c8e4d7d7b.png[/img]

Previously, there were unclear mission objectives, and victories or failures would often occur unexpectedly. So, I added a mission progress bar that increases as enemies are killed, points are captured, and time passes. Now, all mission objectives in all game modes can be summarized as filling the progress bar before the enemy does, and different player actions have varying effects on the bar's filling rate in different mission modes. In boss levels, the progress bar is significantly delayed, and killing the boss immediately fills it.

Balance adjustments:
- Increased acceleration and in-place rotation speed for Tiger E and Panther G, as advanced levels were becoming too sluggish.
- Reduced enemy stat enhancements when players use high rank vehicles.

Added the ability to reload the magazine cannon with the R key.
Try to fix the issue with shortcut keys not working. If it works in the new version, please let me know.
Finally remembered to add the Mule Rocket Launcher to the shop.
Fixed the issue where the player would get stuck if they died after winning.
Fixed the issue with hull upgrades not being effective.
Fixed the occasional occurrence of sub turret shooting main turret shells.
Reduced the recoil when various autocannon hit.
Renamed the shop to Grocery Store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089194/84ca97b70825b2e7b1eb82ca6bf3fb9536da6146.png[/img]

Add a feature to sort turrets in the storage ui, and attempt to fix turret-related bugs. 
Two new hull upgrades: concrete front armor and concrete side armor. 
Optimize the garage to reduce sudden tank jerking movements.

The turret list now includes the option to sell turrets. 
Improved the maneuverability of various light tanks. 
Now, if a player is inside the target point in a defensive map, enemies cannot capture it. 
Fixed the issue where small caliber HE shells were not causing damage. 
Fixed the problem where sometimes abandoning a mission did not reset the mission list.

[olist]
[*] Adjusted the damage of the 38T Anti-Aircraft to 2. 
[*] Lowered the overall volume slightly. 
[*] Further fixed the errors in the English text.
[/olist]

Fixing the bug that causes fixed enemy types. 
Fixing the issue with English text display.

[olist]
[*] Fixed the bug where players sometimes couldn't revive after death. 
[*] Attempted to fix the issue where shortcuts would sometimes stop working. Additionally, enabled mouse clicks for certain buttons, so even if shortcuts don't work, players can still click on them. 
[*] Friend NicoX helped polish the English translation!
[/olist]

notes.title: Future Update Preview~~
notes.notes:
The number of players who have been playing these past few days has been tremendous, and they have provided valuable feedback. I am truly grateful! 😄
Next, I will focus on fixing some of the widely mentioned issues as soon as possible:

[olist]
[*] Fixing bugs, such as the problem where players sometimes cannot revive after death.
[*] Adding the ability to sell and rearrange turrets.
[*] Adding a settings interface for adjusting window size and volume.
[*] Some players feel that the levels are too short and end too quickly. I will adjust the pacing of the levels based on the feedback received in the past two days, primarily by reducing Non-combat time, extending overall battle duration, and increasing player decision-making opportunities.
[/olist]
There will be frequent updates coming up, so those who are interested can keep an eye out daily. Thank you, my friends! 😆

[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue with the inability to drag and view character illustrations. 
[*] Fixed the issue where selecting mission rewards twice in a row would result in the same options. 
[*] Added promotional content to the main interface, which will be removed in the final version.
[/olist]
